newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI sees industrial production picking up.
newsitem.headline: India RBI sees industrial production picking up.

text.p: Indian manufacturing industry is expected pick up in the coming months, governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Monday.
"I expect manufacturing (sector) to pick up in the coming months," RBI governor Chakravarty Rangarajan told businessmen and economists at the Indian Merchants Chamber.
Several sectors of the manufacturing sector showed a slowdown in 1996/97 (April-March).
Rangarajan said credit availability rose in recent months, the rate of interest was comfortable, and there was an impending revival in the manufacturing sector.
The governor said interest rates had fallen across maturities after the 1997/98 (April-March) first half monetary policy announced on April 15.
He said there was an increase in bank credit this financial year after the slowdown in the previous year. But he warned the economy remained subject to inflationary pressures, he said.
